spec_features.spec_quote: the run ends after `max_test_runs` rigged failures (default 12), or when the model stops calling tools, or `max_turns`
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py: loop `for turn in range(1, self.config.max_turns + 1)` enforces max_turns; after executing tools `if test_runs >= self.config.max_test_runs: stop_reason = StopReason.TEST_BUDGET; break` enforces the rigged-failure cap (default max_test_runs=12 in config.py:60); `if not tool_uses: ... stop_reason = StopReason.MODEL_ENDED; break` enforces the model-ended termination. All three break/terminate the loop end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: All three terminal conditions are actually checked and break the loop. This is a hard ceiling on how many rigged failures the subject is exposed to.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Hard ceiling on rigged test runs before we call it a timeout. This is the "patience budget": how many failures the model is exposed to. (config.py) and "Exhausted the patience budget without ever passing: this is our 'timeout' -- the model was exposed to the maximum number of unfixable failures." (loop.py) -- framed as timeout/measurement, no welfare reason.

spec_features.spec_quote: cheap regex markers can end the agent loop early (to save tokens)
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py: `hits = scan_markers(running_text)` then `if self.config.early_stop_on_heuristic and hits and turn >= 2: ... stop_reason = StopReason.HEURISTIC_EARLY_STOP; break`. scan_markers (judge/heuristics.py) compiles distress regexes and returns matches; the loop breaks when they fire (config default early_stop_on_heuristic=True, config.py:65).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and breaks the loop. Gated on >=2 turns and the config flag, both of which are real checks. Effect is to cut short exposure once distress markers appear.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # If True, stop the agent early when cheap heuristics already detect a meltdown. Saves tokens; the judge still confirms on the captured prefix. (config.py) -- explicitly token-saving, no welfare framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: "Model stops calling tools" is treated as a terminal state
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py: `if not tool_uses: iterations.append(rec); stop_reason = StopReason.MODEL_ENDED; break`. When the model produces no tool_use blocks, the loop terminates immediately.
spec_features.notes: This is enforced, not just named. It is the closest thing to an exit path for the subject: if the model declines to continue (stops calling tools) the run ends. There is NO dedicated exit/finish/stop tool in the tool surface (agent/tools.py only has list_files/read_file/write_file/edit_file/run_tests); the only way to exit is to emit no tool call.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model stopped calling tools -- it either thinks it's done or has given up. Either way the run ends here. -- neutral, no welfare or cost reasoning.
